verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an LLM-friendly index at https://docs.openhands.dev/llms.txt that explicitly targets V1 docs. The SDK guides are also served as raw .md pages, giving agents machine-readable docs to point at, and an openapi.json is available as a further agent-consumable spec. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing how agents should consume llms.txt or the .md docs (e.g. any llms-full.txt variant), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs effectively.
